title: 第1章 公务员考试(上)
content_zh:
早春四月正是草长莺飞，纸鸢乱舞的时节，到处都是一派欣欣向荣的景象。

天气虽然已经转暖，但是今年河西省省会南平市的春天却迎来了一个倒春寒，天空有些阴沉，整个城市上空雾气蒙蒙的，街上的行人稀少，即使走在街上的人也纷纷捂紧衣领，半闭着双眼迎着沙尘暴缓慢的前行。

然而，在南平市省公安厅门前却人声鼎沸，三个一群两个一伙的聚拢在一起，说说笑笑十分热闹。与街上那稀稀落落的行人形成了鲜明对比。在大门口右侧树立着一个牌子，上面写着几个大字：河西省公安厅公务员面试考生等候区。

刘飞站在梧桐树下，静静的一个人站在那里，胸前的准考证在春风中左右摇晃着。

公务员笔试的成绩已经下来了，他在全省公务员统一考试中，成绩排在第一名。对于这个结果他没有感到意外，四年前他就是以河西省理科状元的身份考上的北大。经过四年大学生活的磨砺，对于这次面试他同样充满了期待和自信，他相信，只要公平公正的考试，他有信心在现场四十多名考生中独领**，笑傲群雄。

距离刘飞不远站着几名考生，他们似乎认识，正在讨论这次面试。

“张龙，这次这次省公安厅只录取一名公务员，应试的确有20名考生，你有把握吗？”

“当然有把握，这次负责面试的考官刘处长是我爸爸的铁哥们！”

“我晕，就一个刘处长你就认为你有把握啊，我真是服了你了，我爸爸已经跟省公安厅的黄副厅长打过招呼了，这次我感觉把握十足。”

“切，赵虎，你以为黄福厅长很牛吗？我爸经常和省公安厅的常务副厅长孙耀威一起喝酒，这次我可是拿了孙厅长的条子来的。”说话的是一个身材瘦削的男孩，戴着一个金边眼镜，看起来文质彬彬的样子，只是他那眼神中带着十分的傲气，脸上露出一副不屑的表情。

另外两个男孩听到这里，神情有些沮丧。

然而，这时，旁边一个身高1米80左右的胖子突然说道：“王朝，不是我打击你，这次考试咱们谁都没戏！不过是走走过场而已。真正的大角色在那里！”说着，他用手一指距离他们五米远的一颗树下站着的一个男孩。那个男孩身材高大，样貌俊朗，穿着一身深色西服，打着领带，右手无名指上戴着一枚银光闪烁的钻戒，脸上挂着一丝淡定的微笑。

胖子说道:“他就是省公安厅厅长赵永的亲侄子，赵世杰。我可是听说了，这次面试之前，赵世杰已经把这次考试的主考官都一一拜访过了，你们说他来了，咱们还有戏吗？”

众人此刻都有些沮丧，但是张龙却突然用手一指刘飞说道：“看到那个人了吗？他叫刘飞，是这次笔试的全省状元，每科考试成绩都是满分！我想他是赵世杰真正的对手！”

听到他们的议论，刘飞笑了：“看来我的名气在考生中之中倒是蛮大的嘛！”不过听几个人这么一议论，刘飞对旁边那棵梧桐树下站着的帅气男孩倒也产生了几分兴趣，便看了过去，正在这时，那个男孩也看了过来。两人的目光在空中交接在一起。谁也没有退让，无形之中仿佛有一种电火花在闪烁着，激烈的碰撞着。

刘飞淡淡一笑收回目光，他看出来了，对面那个男孩看起来和自己一个，是一个信心很足而且很嚣张的人，但是刘飞也能感受到，在那个男孩的目光中闪烁着一种嘲讽和蔑视。似乎在场的人没有一个能值得做他的对手。看起来他对这次考试也是势在必得。而且刘飞也曾经关注过这次考试的成绩榜，赵世杰的成绩虽然没有自己考的好，但是也考的还算不错，在全省排在前50名。

就在这个时候，赵世杰向着刘飞走了过来，在距离刘飞两米远的地方站定，玩味的眼神打量了刘飞几眼，才用一种居高临下的语气说道：“你就是刘飞？”

刘飞很不喜欢他这种说话的语气，似乎他天生就高人一等似的。于是，刘飞冷冷的看了他一眼，抬头仰望天空，似乎天空中有一幕精彩的三级片在上映一般，丝毫没有把旁边的赵世杰放在眼里。

这时，旁边那几个原本正在议论两个人的男孩也看了过来，看到刘飞居然连甩都不不甩赵世杰，胖子小声的说道：“我草，这赵世杰就够嚣张够高傲的了，没想这个刘飞居然比他还要嚣张，这下可有好戏看了，我跟你们说啊，别看赵世杰看起来人模狗样的，其实那小子花花肠子多着呢，他在我们清华可是出了名的阴险角色，而且睚眦必报！”

张龙道：“这下刘飞可是有麻烦了。”

赵世杰也能感觉到周围那些看热闹的目光，在看到自己和刘飞打招呼而刘飞居然一点面子都不给自己，顿时脸色就变了，脸上的笑容更浓了，只是眼神中的寒意却也越来越发浓郁，眼底深处一种阴鸷之色飘然而过，但是说话的声音却相当爽朗：“刘飞同学，我叫赵世杰，清华大学的，我有话想单独和你谈一谈。”这次他说话的语气没有了那种高高在上的姿态。

刘飞这才低下头来，面带微笑着说道：“赵世杰同学是吧，你好你好，有什么话就在这里说吧，我刘飞做任何事情都喜欢光明正大的！”

赵世杰顿时语塞，脸色青一阵白一阵的变化了好几次，呼吸瞬间变得急促了许多，胸部起伏着，脸上怒气冲天，不过很快他又镇定下来，迈步向前走了两步，凑到刘飞的身边从口袋中掏出一张支票递向刘飞，小声说道：“刘飞，这是10万块钱的支票，只要你退出这次面试，这10万块钱就是你的了，我知道你在北大日子过得非常清苦，每天总是跟着别人蹭饭吃。只要你退出这次面试，明年我保证你考中河西省任何地方的公务员。”

虽然赵世杰的声音很小，但是距离他们不远处的胖子和张龙、赵虎、王朝他们也都听到了，他们不由得纷纷摇头，既为赵世杰这手金钱诱惑的高招赞叹不已，又为刘飞受不了这种诱惑而叹息。胖子更是叹息的说道：“哎，这个赵世杰真是够阴险的啊，居然玩这一手，看来他对这次公安厅这唯一的名额是势在必得啊！”

王朝也说道：“看来刘飞是肯定会选择退出了，毕竟明年赵世杰能够保证他也能考中！如果换成我我也会选择退出的。”

看到刘飞接过支票，赵世杰不由得再次高高的扬起头来，展现出那种高人一等的姿态，嘴角上露出一丝不屑和嘲讽，心中说道：“哼，刘飞你倒是还给我装逼啊，老子就不信10万块钱不把你砸晕了！至于明年你能不能考中，鬼才管你呢！”

刘飞接过支票，目光在上面扫了一眼，右手捏着支票一角，左手轻轻的弹了弹支票，冲着赵世杰说道：“你很希望我退出这次面试吗？难道你对自己没有信心吗？”

赵世杰撇撇嘴：“我对自己一向信心十足，只是不想多出你这个变数而已。”

刘飞的目光在赵世杰脸上停留了片刻，突然呵呵的笑了起来，右手一甩，那张支票宛如一道利剑一般，噗的一下插在赵世杰西装的领口上，卡在那里，赵世杰的脸色顷刻之间就变了：“你什么意思？难道嫌钱少吗？我在给你加五万好了！”

刘飞竖起食指在赵世杰的面前摇晃了几下，淡淡一笑：“钱是好东西，但是哥的心情比钱更重要！只有考上了这个公务员哥我的心情才会好起来，所以这钱，还是留着你下次考公务员的时候行贿用吧！”

说完，刘飞转过身去，伸了伸懒腰喃喃的说道：“这等候的时间过的真是漫长啊！”

赵世杰的眼神之中闪过一丝愤恨之色，阴鸷的目光恶狠狠的盯着刘飞说道：“哼，就算你参加面试也不可能得高分的，这次的考官我都已经疏通好了！今天的面试，我才是唯一的胜利者！”

看到刘飞拒绝了赵世杰的支票和承诺，胖子和张龙赵虎王朝几乎同时使劲握紧拳头挥舞了一下，同时说道：“刘飞，好样的！你才是真正的男人！”

“各位考生准备了，各位考生准备了，请准备好准考证和身份证，排队进入大门，跟我一起到会议室去！面试在有10分钟马上就开始！”一个中年考官手中拿着扩音器站在门口冲着外面喊道，考生们很快就自觉的排成一条长龙，依次进入，刘飞也汇入到这条长龙里，跟随着大部队徐徐向会议室走去。

考场设在在公安厅的大会议室内，外面是大会议上，会议室里间有一个小型会议室。

考试之前，由那个中年考官先宣读了考试规则。然后是考官们和考生们见了一面。

这次考官一共是7个人，由公安厅人事处的杜处长任主考官，其他六位副主考官也都是公安厅各个处室的主要领导，当然其中还包括这次录用人的刑侦处处长王海鸣。

在与考官见面时，刘飞一直默默观察着场中的形式，他发现大部分考生都会与几位考官中的某位用眼神沟通沟通，而其中风头最劲的莫过于赵世杰了，刘飞发现7位考官中的五位都对赵世杰露出了笑容，或者是冲他点点头，其中意思不言而喻。尤其是刑侦处的王处长，更是在擦身而过的时候，轻轻拍了拍赵世杰的肩膀，冲他点头笑了笑。

见面完成以后，则是五分钟的考生准备时间。赵世杰则冲刘飞递过一道轻蔑的眼神，然后用手点点刘飞，伸出大拇指，向下翻转。刘飞则比他更加直接，直接对他竖起了中指，气得赵世杰当时就转过头去，刘飞则轻轻的笑了起来。
content_en:
In early spring, April is the time when grass grows and orioles fly, and paper kites dance wildly. There is a thriving scene everywhere.

Although the weather has gotten warmer, this year's spring in Nanping City, the capital of Hexi Province, has ushered in a late spring cold. The sky is a bit gloomy, the sky is foggy over the entire city, and there are few pedestrians on the streets. Even those walking on the streets are holding their collars tight and slowly moving forward with half-closed eyes facing the sandstorm.

However, there was a buzz of people in front of the Nanping Provincial Public Security Department. Three groups of two gathered together, chatting and laughing in a lively manner.It was in sharp contrast to the sparse pedestrians on the street.There is a sign on the right side of the gate with several large characters written on it: Waiting area for civil servant interview candidates of the Hexi Provincial Public Security Department.

Liu Fei stood under the sycamore tree, standing there quietly alone, the admission ticket on his chest swaying left and right in the spring breeze.

The results of the civil service written examination have come down. He ranked first in the province's unified civil service examination.He was not surprised by this result. Four years ago, he was admitted to Peking University as the top science student in Hexi Province.After four years of college life, he is also full of expectations and confidence for this interview. He believes that as long as the exam is fair and impartial, he is confident that he will lead the field among the more than 40 candidates and stand out from the crowd.

Not far from Liu Fei stood several candidates. They seemed to know each other and were discussing the interview.

"Zhang Long, this time the Provincial Public Security Department only admitted one civil servant. There are indeed 20 candidates for the exam. Are you sure?"

"Of course I'm sure. Director Liu, the examiner in charge of the interview this time, is my father's best friend!"

"I'm dizzy. You're just Director Liu and you think you're sure. I'm really convinced by you. My dad has already said hello to Deputy Director Huang of the Provincial Public Security Department. I feel very sure this time."

"Tch, Zhao Hu, do you think Director Huang Fu is awesome? My dad often drinks with Sun Yaowei, the executive deputy director of the Provincial Public Security Department, and this time I got a note from Director Sun." The speaker was a thin boy, wearing gold-rimmed glasses, who looked polite, but his eyes were very arrogant, and his face showed a look of disdain.

The other two boys looked a little depressed when they heard this.

However, at this time, a fat man about 1.80 meters tall next to him suddenly said: "Dynasty, I'm not trying to hit you, none of us can do anything in this exam! It's just a formality. The real big role is there!" As he said, he pointed to a boy standing under a tree five meters away from them.The boy was tall and handsome, wearing a dark suit and tie. He wore a sparkling silver diamond ring on his right ring finger and had a calm smile on his face.

The fat man said: "He is Zhao Shijie, the nephew of Zhao Yong, director of the Provincial Public Security Department. I heard that before this interview, Zhao Shijie had visited all the examiners of this exam one by one. Do you think we can still have a chance if he comes?"

Everyone was a little frustrated at this moment, but Zhang Long suddenly pointed at Liu Fei and said, "Did you see that person? His name is Liu Fei, he is the top scorer in the province in this written examination, and his scores are perfect in every subject! I think he is Zhao Shijie's real opponent!"

Hearing their discussion, Liu Fei smiled: "It seems that my reputation is quite big among the candidates!" However, after hearing a few people's comments, Liu Fei became somewhat interested in the handsome boy standing under the sycamore tree next to him, so he looked over. At this moment, the boy also looked over.Their eyes met in the air.No one gave in. There seemed to be electric sparks flickering and fierce collisions.

Liu Fei smiled faintly and looked away. He could see that the boy opposite looked like him, a very confident and arrogant person, but Liu Fei could also feel that there was a kind of ridicule and contempt in the boy's eyes.It seemed that no one present was worthy of being his opponent.It seems that he is also determined to win this exam.Moreover, Liu Fei had also paid attention to the score list of this exam. Although Zhao Shijie's score was not as good as his own, he still did pretty well, ranking among the top 50 in the province.

At this time, Zhao Shijie walked towards Liu Fei, stood two meters away from Liu Fei, looked at Liu Fei with playful eyes, and then said in a condescending tone: "Are you Liu Fei?"

Liu Fei didn't like the tone of his voice very much, as if he was inherently superior to others.So, Liu Fei glanced at him coldly, looked up at the sky, as if there was a wonderful third-level movie showing in the sky, and did not take Zhao Shijie next to him at all.

At this time, the boys next to them who were originally discussing the two people also looked over. Seeing that Liu Fei didn't even dump Zhao Shijie, the fat man said in a low voice: "Fuck, this Zhao Shijie is arrogant and arrogant enough. I didn't expect Liu Fei to be here."Even more arrogant than him, this is going to be a good show. Let me tell you, even though Zhao Shijie looks like a dog, in fact, that kid has a lot of tricks. He is a well-known insidious character in our Tsinghua University, and he will be punished!"

Zhang Long said: "Liu Fei is in trouble now."

Zhao Shijie could also feel the eyes of those watching the fun around him. When he saw that he was greeting Liu Fei and Liu Fei didn't give him any face, his expression suddenly changed. The smile on his face became thicker, but the coldness in his eyes became more and more intense.A sinister look passed through his eyes, but his voice was quite cheerful: "Classmate Liu Fei, my name is Zhao Shijie, from Tsinghua University. I have something to talk to you about alone." This time, his tone of voice was no longer condescending.

Liu Fei then lowered his head and said with a smile: "Classmate Zhao Shijie, right? Hello, hello. If you have anything to say, just say it here. I, Liu Fei, like to be fair and aboveboard in everything I do!"

Zhao Shijie was at a loss for words. His face turned blue and white several times, his breathing became much faster in an instant, his chest heaved, and his face was filled with anger. But he soon calmed down again, took two steps forward, approached Liu Fei, took out a check from his pocket and handed it to Liu Fei, and whispered:"Liu Fei, this is a check for 100,000 yuan. As long as you withdraw from this interview, this 100,000 yuan will be yours. I know that you live a very poor life at Peking University and always follow others for food every day. As long as you withdraw from this interview, next year I guarantee that you will pass the civil servant examination anywhere in Hexi Province."

Although Zhao Shijie's voice was very low, the fat man, Zhang Long, Zhao Hu, and Chao Chao who were not far away from them also heard it. They couldn't help but shake their heads, admiring Zhao Shijie's clever trick of seducing money, and sighing because Liu Fei couldn't stand this temptation.The fat man even sighed and said: "Hey, this Zhao Shijie is really insidious. He actually played this trick. It seems that he is bound to get the only spot in the Public Security Department this time!"

Chao Chao also said: "It seems that Liu Fei will definitely choose to quit. After all, Zhao Shijie can guarantee that he will pass the exam next year! If it were me, I would choose to quit."

Seeing Liu Fei taking the check, Zhao Shijie couldn't help but raise his head high again, showing that superior attitude, with a trace of disdain and ridicule on the corner of his mouth, and said in his heart: "Huh, Liu Fei, you are still pretending to be cool, I don't believe that 100,000 yuan will not knock you out! As for whether you can pass the exam next year, the devil has no business with you!"

Liu Fei took the check, glanced at it, held the corner of the check with his right hand, flicked the check gently with his left hand, and said to Zhao Shijie: "Do you really hope that I withdraw from this interview? Don't you have confidence in yourself?"

Zhao Shijie pouted: "I have always been confident in myself, I just don't want to be a variable like you."

Liu Fei's eyes stayed on Zhao Shijie's face for a moment, and suddenly he laughed. With a flick of his right hand, the check was inserted into the collar of Zhao Shijie's suit like a sharp sword, and it got stuck there. Zhao Shijie's expression changed instantly: "What do you mean? Do you think the money is too little? I'll give you an extra fifty thousand!"

Liu Fei raised his index finger and shook it in front of Zhao Shijie a few times, then smiled faintly: "Money is a good thing, but my mood is more important than money! My mood will get better only if I pass the civil service exam, so I'd better keep this money for bribery when you take the civil service exam next time!"

After saying that, Liu Fei turned around, stretched and murmured: "The waiting time has been really long!"

A hint of resentment flashed in Zhao Shijie's eyes, and he stared at Liu Fei with a sinister gaze and said, "Huh, even if you participate in the interview, you can't get high marks. I have already cleared the examiners this time! I am the only winner in today's interview!"

Seeing Liu Fei rejecting Zhao Shijie's check and promise, Fatty and Zhang Long Zhao Hu Chao almost simultaneously clenched their fists and waved them, and said at the same time: "Liu Fei, good job! You are the real man!"

"Candidates are ready. Candidates are ready. Please prepare your admission ticket and ID card, line up to enter the gate, and come with me to the conference room! The interview will start in 10 minutes!" A middle-aged examiner stood at the door with a loudspeaker in his hand and shouted outside. The candidates quickly formed a long queue and entered one by one. Liu Fei also merged into this long queue and followed the large group slowly towards the conference room.

The examination room is located in the large conference room of the Public Security Department. Outside is the large conference room, and there is a small conference room in the conference room.

Before the exam, the middle-aged examiner first read out the exam rules.Then the examiners met with the candidates.

There are seven examiners in total this time. Director Du from the Human Resources Department of the Public Security Department is the examiner. The other six deputy examiners are also the main leaders of various departments of the Public Security Department. Of course, they also include Wang Haiming, the director of the Criminal Investigation Division who is hiring this time.

When meeting with the examiners, Liu Fei had been silently observing the situation. He found that most candidates would communicate with one of the examiners through their eyes, and the most popular among them was Zhao Shijie. Liu Fei found that five of the seven examiners smiled at Zhao Shijie or nodded at him, and the meaning was self-evident.Especially Director Wang from the Criminal Investigation Department, when he passed by, he patted Zhao Shijie's shoulder gently, nodded and smiled at him.

After the interview is completed, there will be five minutes of candidate preparation time.Zhao Shijie gave Liu Fei a contemptuous look, then tapped Liu Fei with his hand, stretched out his thumb, and turned it down.Liu Fei was more direct than him and raised his middle finger directly at him. Zhao Shijie was so angry that he turned his head away while Liu Fei laughed softly.
